method: Visual reading of 18 blind image sheets (10 items each) in immutable review order, with targeted enlarged original scan reinspection. Reader predictions and flagged/accepted strata were hidden during transcription. Labels frozen before comparison to OCR outputs.
scope: Owner-delegated GPT reference, not independent human-verified ground truth. Original nine human GT templates untouched.
transcription_policy: Numeric typography: join digit-group spaces, preserve printed decimal places/leading zeroes and thousands commas; ASCII minus for printed minus. Footnote markers are separate from cell values. Mark fragments/merged cells/non-numeric glyphs not_number. Uncertain decimal separator is illegible; never infer from arithmetic.
